The class's central finding is a rig-limitation finding (cut counts are not edit rates for animation: continuous take reads 0, line boil reads 300) — documented as a measurement boundary and an explicit v0.3 rig item, not normalized away; motion and loudness metrics remain valid and are what the class rules use. Same disposition as study-round3/6/7/8/9: no bad receipts remain.

sheet-reads (llm gate): 4/4 sources read at judge time via the free opencode muse vision lane. Luxo Jr. (dense fps=1/8 montage): small desk lamp bouncing a ball, parent lamp reacting, dark stage + wood floor — exactly the 1986 short. RSA Animate: 36 frames of hand drawing text/pictures on white paper in black+red ('AUTONOMY MASTERY PURPOSE' etc.) — confirmed. Paperman: monochrome 1930s-40s NY, office worker, paper airplanes, hand-drawn-over-CG look — confirmed (and the reader transcribed the rig's burned-in profile line independently). Powers of Ten (dense montage): picnic -> Chicago lakefront -> Earth -> moon orbit -> solar system -> starfields with centered scale squares, +1 power of ten per step — confirmed on the outward leg; reader correctly noted the return/atom leg was not sampled (25-tile cap at fps=1/8 on a 541s source) — sampling caveat documented in PLAYBOOK.

Slug-to-content pairing confirmed for all 4 R10 fetches; two official channels (Royal Society of Arts u6XAPnuFjJc, Eames Office 0fKBhvDjuy0) and two clean fan uploads with documented channel caveats (Luxo zmhZm5FRV4s, Paperman XrqSF2OOz_M — no official channel upload surfaced in searches). Receipt source metadata matches each sheet's content; no mislabeled or corrupt receipt this round (the R9 replace-not-merge rule was followed: no same-slug re-fetches were needed).

Rig limitation measured and bounded this round: the scene-cut detector is calibrated for live action and fails IN BOTH DIRECTIONS on animation — a genuinely continuous 131s take reads 0 cuts (correct here, but the detector cannot distinguish intent), while Paperman's within-shot animation change (hand-drawn line boil at 60fps) reads 300 detections (147 hard) against a real cinematic edit, i.e. cut counts are event density, not editorial intent, for animation. Handled by documenting the boundary in the receipt + PLAYBOOK class-A section, restricting class-A published metrics to motion/loudness/palette, and logging the animation-aware threshold (within-shot motion baseline) as rig v0.3. Second smaller item logged: dense-montage rate must scale with source duration (the fps=1/8 25-tile montage covered only the first ~200s of Powers of Ten).

Limits documented, not normalized: animation cut counts explicitly marked invalid (range published with the caveat marker in the PLAYBOOK table); no full video watched; dense-montage sampling gap on the 541s source stated (return leg unsampled, identity confirmed on the outward leg); Luxo/Paperman fan-channel caveats; Paperman loudness carries a 60fps re-encode caveat. n=4 class (one per grammar) flagged for widening. No keys, no paid lanes (free muse vision lane for reads).
